mapper.sql: id, stock_id, sell_price, sell_count, position, sell_commission, sell_transfer_fee, stamp_tax, handling_fee, regulatory_fee, other_fee, net_profit, t_type, t_profit, t_pending, t_group_id, DATE_FORMAT(sell_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS sell_date_str, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at_str
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sell_records WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY sell_date ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT FROM sell_records WHERE stock_id IN #{item} ORDER BY sell_date ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sell_records (id, stock_id, sell_date, sell_price, sell_count, position, sell_commission, sell_transfer_fee, stamp_tax, handling_fee, regulatory_fee, other_fee, net_profit, t_type, t_profit, t_pending, t_group_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{stockId}, #{sellDate}, #{sellPrice}, #{sellCount}, #{position}, #{sellCommission}, #{sellTransferFee}, #{stampTax}, #{handlingFee}, #{regulatoryFee}, #{otherFee}, #{netProfit}, #{tType}, #{tProfit}, #{tPending}, #{tGroupId})
